steps.title: Check Docker Setup
steps.description: First, let's make sure Docker is ready to use in your environment.
tasks: Run `docker --version` to see if Docker is installed
Run `docker info` to check Docker status

steps.title: Pull and Run Your First Container
steps.description: Download a pre-made lightweight Alpine Linux image and run a quick command inside it.
tasks: Download Alpine image: `docker pull alpine:latest`
Run a container that prints a greeting: `docker run alpine echo 'Hello from Docker!'`
List all containers (even stopped ones): `docker ps -a`

verification.command: docker ps -a | grep alpine && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Run a Background Web Server
steps.description: Launch an Nginx web server container running in the background (detached mode) and map port 8080 on your host to port 80 in the container.
tasks: Run Nginx in detached mode: `docker run -d --name my-webserver -p 8080:80 nginx`
Check running containers with `docker ps`
Test the web server response: `curl localhost:8080`

verification.command: docker ps | grep my-webserver && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Shell Into a Running Container
steps.description: Open an interactive shell inside the running Nginx container and explore its filesystem.
tasks: Open a shell: `docker exec -it my-webserver /bin/sh`
Inside the container, run: `cat /etc/nginx/nginx.conf`
Exit the shell: type `exit`
View container logs: `docker logs my-webserver`

verification.command: docker logs my-webserver 2>&1 | head -1 | grep -q '' && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Build a Custom Image
steps.description: Create a Dockerfile and build your own custom Docker image.
tasks: Create a project: `mkdir ~/myapp && cd ~/myapp`

Create an index.html: `echo '

Built with OpsAcademy!

' > index.html`
Create a Dockerfile: `echo 'FROM nginx:alpine' > Dockerfile && echo 'COPY index.html /usr/share/nginx/html/' >> Dockerfile`
Build the image: `docker build -t myapp:v1 .`
Run it: `docker run -d --name myapp -p 9090:80 myapp:v1`

verification.command: docker images | grep myapp && docker ps | grep myapp && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Inspect and Clean Up
steps.description: View logs from your containers and safely stop and remove everything.
tasks: Check container resource usage: `docker stats --no-stream`
Stop all running containers: `docker stop my-webserver myapp`
Remove stopped containers: `docker rm my-webserver myapp`
Verify cleanup: `docker ps -a` should show no containers

verification.command: docker ps -a | grep -E 'my-webserver|myapp' && echo FAIL || echo PASS
